checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Exact TopModule interface with 8-bit input in and 1-bit output parity. Continuous XOR reduction implements combinational even parity with no clock, reset, storage, or added latency.

checks.name: independent exhaustive development test
checks.details: dev_tb.sv checks all 256 byte values against independently counted set-bit parity. Icarus compilation used -g2012, -Wall and explicit top dev_tb with a 20-second timeout, but exited 139 with empty compile.log. Matching vvp was attempted with a 20-second timeout and reported that dev_sim could not be opened. No simulation pass is claimed.

development_outcome: Initial synthesizable candidate delivered unchanged and preserved as candidate_initial.sv. Static review passed; development simulation unavailable due to compiler failure.
limitations: Exhaustive testbench was written but could not run because development compilation failed.
No synthesis, timing analysis, or board validation performed.
